p0_findings.finding: The consumer still calls Path.resolve before checking directory.is_symlink. Expected internal leaf members are checked correctly, but the canonical root leaf can be a symlink and extra directory entries are ignored.
p0_findings.minimal_fix: Validate exact lexical canonical directory and reject its symlink before resolve; count every immediate directory entry.

p0_findings.finding: Staging ignores non-file entries and does not reverify every member digest before rename. A postpublish failure or kill leaves canonical RUN_COMPLETE and seals because there is no quarantine path/trap.
p0_findings.minimal_fix: Run the full consumer verifier on staging before rename and after rename; on any ordinary postpublish failure atomically quarantine canonical before raising and verify the postcondition.

p1_findings.finding: Waiting only covers an already-running exact watcher tag and has no timeout or periodic state receipt.
A second idle query narrows but does not eliminate noncooperating launch races; exact one-A800 UUID/model/driver/index0 is recorded only as raw CSV and not enforced.
Major import roots and dangerous environment variables are handled, but repo-root import shadows and DSEC sample-content identity remain incomplete.
Attempt/result creation still lacks an EXIT failure marker or partial-result quarantine, leaving non-rerunnable ambiguous artifacts on early failures.
Final semantics do not cross-check all factor receipt config/source/epoch36/epoch40/state hashes with current artifacts and only type-check the propagated M513 identity.
The persisted end SHA is sampled before final package staging, sealing, publication and postverification; no fourth actual SHA is sampled after publication.

decision.reason: Two r2 P0s are correctly closed, but the M513 root path and final canonical publication remain fail-open. P0 must be zero before launch.
required_before_r4: M513 lexical root non-symlink check before resolve and every-entry population
atomic canonical quarantine on postpublication failure
